description:
Read up to 5 cases found by search_cases. Pick sections to save context: problem, solution, tools,
core_idea, how_to_apply, code, results, limitations, talk (full edited transcript of a talk, paged with offset).
Default: problem, solution, core_idea, results, limitations (~1k tokens per card); ask for how_to_apply / code when the user is going to
implement. Open about 3 cards per call; the response is capped by max_tokens (default 5000). Every card also returns `materials`:
the original (url, format, language, access: open | video | paywall | bot-blocked | offline, with a note on how to
get it), the transcript if there is one, code repositories, slides and other extras. Use them as described in the
server instructions; ask the user to fetch an original you cannot access.

max_tokens.description: Approximate cap on the response size; long sections are truncated.

offset.description: Character offset for the talk section.

search_id.description: search_id of the search these cases came from (for logging relevance).

sections.description: Card sections to return; default: problem, solution, core_idea, results, limitations. 'talk' = full transcript, paged with offset.

slugs.description: Case slugs from search_cases results (the `slug` field).

name: get_cards
title: Read cases
